_handoff.scope: Public first-person accounts about Bengaluru/BBMP building-plan approval only. They expose possible uncertainty and delay; they are not current zoning rules, approval criteria, professional requirements, fees, or a basis to pay an unofficial intermediary. Names, usernames, plot details, addresses, application identifiers, contact information, and other personal data are intentionally omitted.

sources.title: Has BBMP slowed down or stopped building plan approvals?
sources.notes: A citizen reports having applied for a small residential plan and perceiving the approval as stuck. The post does not establish the application date, jurisdiction, completeness, scrutiny state, cause, or current BBMP approval volume.

sources.title: Asked to pay bribe for construction permission...Again! :D
sources.notes: A citizen constructing a commercial building reports being told that treatment of a nearby road could affect the apparent proposal and reports an unofficial payment demand. The account is unverified and does not establish any road-classification rule, permission entitlement, official fee, or misconduct finding.

claims.text: One citizen reported that a residential building-plan application appeared stuck after submission.
claims.notes: One applicant's reported status, not proof of a systemwide slowdown, a statutory delay, or the cause of the case state.

claims.text: One citizen reported being told that how a road adjacent to a commercial proposal was treated could affect the apparent floor and parking options, alongside an alleged unofficial payment demand.
claims.notes: A single unverified account. It is not evidence of a rule, entitlement, approved design, official charge, or misconduct determination.

claims.text: The citizen accounts do not establish the competent authority, applicable rules, required professional, document set, scrutiny outcome, fee, inspection, licence, or timeline for a particular Bengaluru building-plan case.
claims.notes: No application, upload, payment, inspection request, or case lookup was performed.

roadblocks.title: Reported plan application appears pending without a verified cause
roadblocks.symptom: A citizen reports a submitted residential plan appearing stuck.
roadblocks.likelyCause: Unknown; the account cannot distinguish jurisdiction, completeness, scrutiny, objection, workflow, or case-specific conditions.
roadblocks.recovery: Obtain an authorised case-specific status and written reason through the relevant authority's current route. Do not infer a general approval halt from this account.

roadblocks.title: Reported uncertainty about proposal treatment and road classification
roadblocks.symptom: A citizen reports conflicting practical expectations around road treatment, floor count and parking for a commercial proposal.
roadblocks.likelyCause: Unknown; the report does not validate road status, applicable rules, proposal details, authority or advice received.
roadblocks.recovery: Seek written, authorised clarification from the competent planning authority or a properly qualified professional. Do not use or pay an unofficial route based on this account.
